title: Local Morphology of the Partition Graph
summary: For a fixed integer $n$, let $G_n$ be the graph whose vertices are the partitions of $n$, with adjacency defined by a single elementary transfer of a cell in the Ferrers diagram. In a previous paper, the clique complex $K_n = \mathrm{Cl}(G_n)$ was studied from a global homotopy-theoretic point of view. This paper studies instead the local combinatorics of the graph $G_n$ itself. For a partition $λ=(s_1^{m_1},\dots,s_t^{m_t})$, where $s_1>\dots>s_t>0$, we describe the admissible transfers from $λ$ in terms of its block structure.
